questions.q: How old was Sarah when she died?
choices: An hundred and seven and twenty years
questions.explain: She died in Kirjatharba, the same is Hebron, in the land of Canaan.

questions.q: How did Abraham get the field of Machpelah?
choices: Ephron gave it to him free
He insisted on paying, four hundred shekels of silver
Abimelech gave it as a gift
questions.explain: The field and its cave were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace.
